title: Crying Emoji: Copy & Paste 😭 Tears, Emoticons & Combos
meta_description: Copy and paste crying emoji like 😭 😢 🥹, crying emoticons such as :'( and tearful combo sets for captions and replies.
hero_tagline: Every crying emoji from full 😭 sobbing to 🥹 held-back tears, plus typed :'( emoticons and ready-made tear combos. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The crying emoji is one of the most-used characters on the internet. 😭 Alone doubles as genuine sobbing and exaggerated crying-laughing. This page collects every crying emoji variant, the water and heartbreak symbols that pair with them, the typed :'( emoticon, and one-click combo sets for captions, comments, and group-chat reactions. If you want quieter melancholy rather than open tears, see the sad emoji page linked below.
